scope: Original UX-001..UX-115 completion claims, prioritized history/navigation, workspace, automation, provider, and approval candidates.
inputs: baseline-ledger.json (frozen original acceptance and prior verdicts)
row-results.json and owner row-results under automation, provider, workspace, workflows
rule: A PASS or Verified claim is proposed Verified (scoped) only when fresh evidence exercises the original acceptance for that slice. Candidate or integration status alone is not a missing gate; retain Partial only for a substantive original acceptance aspect still untested or absent. Local fixtures, unavailable providers/devices, and owner acceptance remain explicit limitations.
